messages:
support: Customer #acct-482 reports a spike of 5xxs and timeouts to the hosted API starting ~12:03 UTC. They see lots of 504s and long tails. attaching traces shortly.
liam_oncall: saw alerts: gateway p95 jumped to 3.4s and p99 to 12s around 12:02. Errors are 504 gateway/timeouts. stack shows request_queue_depth hitting the limit on several hosts.
matt_infra: looking at ingress logs now. I see continuous-batcher backlog for model `redwood-open-4` -- pending queue size jumped from ~30 to >900 across shard-03. `max_queue_depth=1024` on that shard.
carol_prod: customer says requests that previously completed in 200-400ms now either 504 or take >8s. They reproduced with small load (~20rps) to that model.
sara_se: repro steps from customer: curl to /v1/complete with prompt small, concurrency 10, steady 15-20rps. They also sent trace id: trace-0a1b2c.
liam_oncall: initial hypothesis: continuous batching backlog + KV cache coldspin -> high per-request queueing until batchers catch up. Could be a hot tenant or request pattern causing oversized batches.
matt_infra: confirmed: batcher metrics show `batch_size` spiking to max and `batch_wait_ms` increasing. Some backends report `eviction_rate` rising (KV cache), and worker threads saturated. Logs:

```
[12:02:18] shard-03 batcher: enqueued=912 max_batch=256 wait_ms=184
[12:02:19] shard-03 worker: kvcache_load=85% evict=120/s threads_busy=64/64
[12:02:20] gateway: request_depth=1024 tenant=acct-482 route=/v1/complete 504
```

carol_prod: any recent deploys or config changes? we didn't push anything global at 11:55.
matt_infra: no deploys. but autoscaler did a delayed scale up (OOM protection kicked in) and we saw a brief CPU spike on shard-03. scaling lagged ~45s.
josh_sre: initial mitigations we can do now:
- throttle tenant acct-482 to 8rps
- temporarily reduce `max_batch_size` to 128 on shard-03 to lower tail latency
- increase worker threads and spin up 2 extra batch workers if possible
- enable immediate fallback to quantized model variant for heavy requests

liam_oncall: I'll apply tenant rate limit and roll a config to reduce `max_batch_size` for the affected pool. doing rate-limit now:

`devops-bot: rate-limit apply tenant=acct-482 rps=8 reason="ingress-surge-3249999999"`

devops-bot: ✅ rate-limit applied (tenant=acct-482, 8rps)

matt_infra: rolling batcher config: `max_batch_size=128` to pool `shard-03-pool`. Starting canary on 2 hosts.

devops-bot: config-rollout started for shard-03-pool (canary=2)

carol_prod: any visible improvement on error rate after the rate limit? customer still seeing some 504s but errors dropped from 18% -> 6% in the last 30s.
sara_se: customer confirms latency improved for small requests but long streaming calls still occasionally 504.
josh_sre: plan next: keep rate-limit, finish rollout of smaller batch size, add 2 workers to shard-03, enable fallback to `redwood-open-4-8q` for requests flagged as heavy (long tokens). Also run a quick replay of their trace to validate.
matt_infra: added 2 workers to pool. `workers=66`. canary passed, rolling to remaining hosts.

devops-bot: workers increased on shard-03-pool, config-rollout progressing (60% hosts updated)

liam_oncall: replaying trace-0a1b2c against canary now to verify no 504s.

devops-bot: trace replay complete: canary responded within 320-480ms for majority, occasional 1.2s.

carol_prod: good. ask customer to hold on further load tests for 10min while we observe. we should also update runbook to include this sequence (throttle -> reduce batch size -> add workers -> fallback).
josh_sre: opened incident postmortem ticket: INC-3249999. Will capture root cause: combined effect of KV cache coldstart, a tenant-pattern causing max-sized batches, and autoscaler lag.
billing: FYI: if we keep rate limits, customer may open a billing dispute for missed SLAs. coordinate with support to offer credit if needed.
sara_se: will coordinate with customer and offer to schedule a brief call after we stabilize. collecting their additional traces.
liam_oncall: monitoring closely. if error rate doesn't drop under 1% in 10m, next: spin up extra shard and temporarily lower `max_queue_depth` to force earlier shedding.

support: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and close the loop once p50/p95 are back to normal. :thumbsup:
